reason: What I run now does the job well enough, and I'm not moving my bookings, drivers and maintenance records onto something brand new that nobody I know has used. Least of all in the middle of excursion and end-of-year season.
objection: Nobody's using it yet. No operator at the association can tell me it holds up on a busy Friday with all the buses out, and if it falls over or the company folds, that's my business and my records gone.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of operators my size at the bus association running it for a season and telling me straight that it's better than what I've got.
